objective: Signed first-order attribution: -(donor - recipient) * gradient KL(p_donor_next_token || p_recipient_next_token). Rank predicted KL reduction, separately per direction and prompt.
limitations: Next-token donor-distribution matching, not a differentiable harmfulness judge or whole-answer safety objective. Layer31 prefill-only patch; free responses require fresh labels. Negative estimated benefits are retained when fixed budgets require them.
